description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thammennagama, Thambuththegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura  District  - Cad. Map No. 110053
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, ownership details, and title classifications, which falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) covering land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
